title: Talk grows, thread wears thin
odia:
କଥାକୁ ମାଜିଲେ ମୋଟା
ସୂତାକୁ ମାଜିଲେ ସରୁ।
literal_meaning: Rub a matter over and it grows thicker; rub a thread and it grows thinner.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ କଥାକୁ ଧରି ବାରମ୍ବାର ଆଲୋଚନା କରି ଚାଲିଲେ ତାହା କ୍ରମେ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ସୂତାକୁ ମାଜିଲେ ସରୁ ହୁଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ କଥାକୁ ସେହିପରି ଘାଣ୍ଟିଲେ ତାହା ଆହୁରି ବଢ଼େ।
explanation: Repeatedly going over a matter can make it grow in importance and extent. The proverb contrasts that growth with a thread becoming thinner through rubbing. The inspected source gloss focuses on dwelling on a matter again and again until it becomes larger.
usage_example: A small disagreement is brought up at every meeting until it overshadows the work itself. Someone could use the saying to point out how repeated discussion has enlarged the quarrel. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The same verb, ମାଜିଲେ, joins two opposite results: a matter becomes thick or large, while a thread becomes thin. That compact reversal turns a familiar physical action into an image of how words can magnify an issue.
